@@U00088@@
What is this vision that suddenly seizes my senses! I feel the holy fire of youth coursing through every vein and nerve! What god was it wrote these symbols that calm the storm of torment inside me; that fill my wretched heart with joy; that with some mysterious force reveals the forces of Nature around me? Am | a god? I? Oh, suddenly it’s all so clear, so clear! I see in the pure lines of this symbol all of Creative Nature at work. I understand the philosopher for the first time. “The spirit world is open, not barred. Your mind is closed, your heart is dead! Rise up, young man, and bathe your breast in the rosy flush of dawn!”

@@U00089@@
(He contemplates the symbol.)

@@U00090@@
Ah! How all things weave into a unity! Each living and working in the other! Heavenly forces ascending, descending, passing golden vessels from hand to hand! Flying on fragrant wings between heaven and earth till all creation sounds with one grand harmony! What a brilliant show! Ah! But only a show.
translation:
@@U00088@@
这突然抓住我感官的景象是什么！我感觉到青春的神圣之火在每一根血管和神经中流淌！到底是哪位上帝写下了这些符号，平息了我内心的痛苦风暴？让我可怜的心充满欢乐；某种神秘的力量揭示了我周围的自然力量？上午 |神？我？哦，突然一切都那么清晰，那么清晰！我在这个符号的纯粹线条中看到了所有创造性的本质在发挥作用。我第一次理解了哲学家。 “精神世界是开放的，不是封闭的。你的思想是封闭的，你的心是死的！站起来，年轻人，让你的胸膛沐浴在黎明的玫瑰色红晕中！”

@@U00089@@
（他凝视着这个符号。）

@@U00090@@
啊！万物如何交织成一个整体！各自生活、工作于对方！天力上升，下降，金器交接！乘着芬芳的翅膀飞翔在天地之间，直到万物发出和谐的声音！多么精彩的表演啊！啊!但只是一场表演。
